title: Lineage screen tree layout and inspector styling

claims.text: .lineage-content lays out the screen as a grid with var(--lin-space-md) gaps, and .lineage-filters is a wrapping flex row with label fields flexing to at least 14rem.
.lineage-children indents nested lists with a 2px inline-start border and connector lines drawn by .lineage-card::before, with the depth-four rule stripping the connector and indent.
A @media (max-width: 34rem) block restacks .lineage-filters as a single-column grid and shrinks .lineage-card padding; .lineage-drawing sets pointer-events: none and caps height at 22rem.

triggers: filters wrapping badly on narrow screen

decision.rule: Change here when the lineage tree layout, filter styling, card or inspector appearance, or small-screen stacking needs to change.
decision.failure: Tree children lose their indent or connectors, cards overflow their column, or the drawing layer captures pointer events.

questions.q: Where is the nested tree indent and connector line drawn for lineage children?
Where should I change the narrow-screen stacking of the lineage filters?
Where does the selected lineage card get its accent border?
